gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Heavy, round, unshaded: College stamps its letters out like cut paper, while Noto Sans Oriya leaves its curves open. Paragraph after paragraph, those generous gaps keep the text easygoing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-palmyren: Chunky confident lettering: College gives curves the full weight of straight stems, while Noto Sans Palmyrene lets its curves stop short. One shouts a little, the other keeps out of its way.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-: Dynamic and authoritative, College hits hard with no tapering at stroke ends, while Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau leaves its curves open. Use College where it can be large; the body font can stay modest.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-phoenici: Noto Sans Phoenician opens its s curves wide at both ends and stands generously high, under the solid, unmodulated line of College. Weight over openness is the standout: a heavy head, a light body.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height and curves that never close. Shrink College and its heavy, thread-thick curves lose their punch, while enlarging the body starts to crowd its tight ascender room.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Authoritative College gives its n arches the full weight of its stems. And where College is best at making a statement, Noto Sans Sharada is best at carrying the sentences.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Dynamic College supplies the heft, drawing curves with no shift from heavy to light inside a stroke. And Noto Sans Siddham, with its large central band, gives that heft something easygoing to sit beside.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: College is a skeleton outline given a single fixed stroke thickness, blunt and commanding. Noto Sans Soyombo takes over for reading, with a sizable x-height and wide, open curves.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-sundanes: A monoline stroke from start to finish gives College its stamped, poster-like look. And College belongs at big sizes and short lengths, while Noto Sans Sundanese handles everything else.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: College draws parallel-edged strokes through every curve, with authority. Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves like a rope's open bight, which lets paragraphs unspool without feeling cramped.
